title: a nuget.config that disables no inherited source
description: nuget.config declares a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled.
limitation: It matches a configuration that leaves every inherited source enabled in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
